complaints.title: Severe faculty deficit in Computer Engineering and non-compliance with AICTE 1:20 cadre ratio
complaints.description: Inspection representation indicates Apex Global Institute is operating with only 6 regular faculty against mandated requirement of 24 in CSE. Ghost faculty names submitted during approval extension.

complaints.title: Faculty salaries withheld for four consecutive months and unauthorized salary deductions
complaints.description: 14 Assistant Professors submitted collective grievance regarding non-payment of UGC/AICTE pay scale salaries since October 2025 and threats of termination upon asking for payment.

complaints.title: Illegal collection of development fee of Rs. 85,000 above state fee committee ceiling
complaints.description: Students admitted under merit quota forced to pay Rs. 85,000 as development and laboratory caution fee without official fee receipt. Refusal to register for semester exams upon non-payment.

complaints.title: Complaint from Parents Association alleging mandatory donation for B.Tech admission
complaints.description: Parents Association submitted memorandum to Regional Office Kolkata stating management is extorting excess capitation fees and refusing to issue standardized receipts.

complaints.title: Refusal to return original 10th & 12th certificates to discontinued student
complaints.description: Student seeking migration to state university denied return of original mark sheets and transfer certificate unless entire course fee of Rs 3.5 Lakhs is cleared in violation of AICTE public notice.

complaints.title: Retention of B.Tech degree certificates and migration certificates demanding full four-year fee
complaints.description: Grievance received from graduate stating institution withheld original degree certificate and migration certificate claiming fictitious hostel dues.

complaints.title: Regional inspection note on defunct computer labs and absence of AICTE fire safety clearance
complaints.description: Surprise scrutiny by Northern Regional Office noted 3 out of 4 computer labs locked with non-functional terminals. Fire safety NOC expired in 2024.

complaints.title: Whistleblower alert alleging fictitious infrastructure shown for 2025-26 approval extension
complaints.description: Petition received by Regulation Bureau stating institution rented computers and temporary faculty on day of AICTE committee visit and dismantled equipment next day.

complaints.title: Unapproved Executive MBA and PGDM dual specialization offered without AICTE sanction
complaints.description: Complainant enrolled in Executive MBA paying Rs. 4 Lakhs discovering degree is awarded by unaccredited offshore entity not approved by AICTE.

complaints.title: Regulatory inquiry into misleading advertisement claiming AICTE approval for online PGDM
complaints.description: RB vigilance notice initiated based on national newspaper advertisements falsely displaying AICTE Approval logo for unauthorized distance learning courses.

complaints.title: Duplication of faculty Aadhaar and PAN credentials in multiple institutions simultaneously
complaints.description: AICTE National Data portal flagged 9 professors of Drona Institute whose biometric records are simultaneously registered in two other institutes in Andhra Pradesh.

complaints.title: Regional surprise check report noting 18 absent faculty listed in AICTE portal database
complaints.description: Regional Officer Hyderabad inspection found only 4 faculty members present during working hours; attendance registers showed fabricated signatures.

complaints.title: Lack of animal house and essential pharmaceutical chemistry instruments as per PCI/AICTE norms

complaints.title: Faculty complaint regarding unsafe chemical storage and unequipped pharmacology laboratory
